objective: Merge reviewed changes faster and with fewer review rounds and CI failures, without losing review evidence coverage or shipping changes that later get reverted.
invariants: no prompt, PR body, review text or diff is collected
a rate is reportable only while review evidence coverage is declared alongside it
an unrecorded review is counted as missing, never as a first-pass success
review evidence coverage stays at or above 0.5

stop_rules.condition: review_evidence_coverage_ratio is below 0.5, so the review rates describe a minority of merged changes.
reverted_merges is above 0 in the window: re-read that change's review evidence before trusting speed gains.
pr_open_to_merge_hours falls while first_pass_review_rate or review_rounds_to_pass worsens.

rollback.trigger: any invariant failure or stop rule
